tmp:2197: pirdah — the she-mule, a hybrid animal born of separation, symbolizing the idolatrous nations (akum) who dwell in peruda/disunity per the Zohar (Mishpatim 95a)
tmp:2198: Sura — the Babylonian river/locale from the Talmudic phrase 'two rivers of Sura,' read as symbol of the idolatrous nations, from 'saru' (they turned aside quickly from the way, Ex. 32:8)
tmp:2199: the evil middot (character traits) of the idolatrous nations — earthly traits to which the nations are bound, constituting the 'yoke of derekh eretz'
tmp:2200: ol derekh eretz — the 'yoke of worldly ways' (Avot 3:5), identified as subjugation to the nations' evil earthly character traits
tmp:2202: physical subjugation (shibud be-gashmiyut) — material servitude to the nations, identified as the 'yoke of government'
tmp:2203: ol malkhut — the 'yoke of government' (Avot 3:5), i.e., political subjugation in the physical realm imposed on one who casts off the yoke of Torah
tmp:2204: meriting the way of teshuvah through the double expertise (baki be-ratzo, baki be-shov), linked to the Name YB"K (=112) of the Elul kavvanot
tmp:2206: the ascent of yirah (fear/awe) to its root in Da'at — symbolized by the frog (tzefardea = tzipor de'ah, 'bird of knowledge'), bird being the aspect of fear
tmp:2207: the ascent/elevation of holiness (aliyat ha-kedushah) — accomplished essentially through joy, as in the future joyous exodus from exile that consumes the kelipot
tmp:2208: amuda de-emtza'ita — the kabbalistic 'middle pillar,' identified with mishpat (judgment), the balanced aim that inclines neither right nor left
tmp:2209: ve-kam ('and a scepter shall arise,' Num. 24:17) — the word 'arise' expounded as the aspect of amidah, standing (prayer), in the verse about the star from Jacob
tmp:2210: goral — the 'lot' (Prov. 18:18) that ends quarrels, identified as the delight of Shabbat (oneg Shabbat), per 'you shall rest and stand for your lot' (Dan. 12:13)
tmp:2211: receiving the Yom Tov (festival), which is Binah — welcoming festival holiness with joy as a segulah against arrogance, via Moshe's forty-nine gates of Binah
tmp:2213: receiving the holiness of Yom Tov (festival sanctity, effected through Torah scholars who elevate Malkhut), which bestows humility and lowliness
tmp:2214: Aron ha-Brit — the Ark of the Covenant in the Tabernacle, symbolizing the poor person (ani) who sits beneath the curtain and receives its bestowal (tzedakah)
tmp:2215: lashon hara — evil/slanderous speech, a vice of the 'medaber' (human) element that brings poverty, paired with idle talk and pride
tmp:2216: meni'ah — an obstacle/hindrance to holiness, identified as cloud-and-fog darkness, from choshekh meaning withholding ('ve-lo chasakhta,' Gen. 22:12)
tmp:2217: anan va-arafel — 'cloud and thick darkness,' the dark screen symbolizing obstacles/withholding (choshekh as language of meni'ah)
tmp:2220: the branches of the tree — one's allotted money/wealth as the anafim spreading out from the trunk that is the light of his soulmate's soul
tmp:2223: the money of those immersed in wealth — riches under the curse 'in sorrow shall you eat' (be-itzavon), bringing sadness, melancholy, and darkened countenance
tmp:2224: atzvut ve-atzlut — sadness and laziness, the serpent's bite arising from the element of earth/dust ('dust is the serpent's food,' Isa. 65:25)
tmp:2225: damim akhurim — turbid/murky blood, the physiological source of sadness and lusts, expelled through salt (the tzaddik as 'covenant of salt')
tmp:2226: sadness and lusts (atzvut ve-ta'avot) — the pair of afflictions arising from turbid blood, rectified via the tzaddik-salt
tmp:2227: Har Sinai — Mount Sinai (tura de-Sinai of the Elders' riddle), symbolizing counsels (etzot), for there Israel received the 613 counsels of Torah
tmp:2228: etzot niv'arot — foolish/senseless counsels, degraded advice of one whose heart is fouled like a privy by the filth of excess
tmp:2229: atzat nashim — the 'counsel of women' (Gittin 45a, in the privy), symbol of impure, unreliable counsel arising from a filth-laden heart
tmp:2230: straightening the crookedness of the heart (akmumiyut she-ba-lev) via thunder — i.e., the forceful voice of prayer, per Berakhot 59a, prerequisite for heart-joy
tmp:2231: the essential extraction (birur) of holy sparks from the kelipot — accomplished through emunah/faith, which like Jerusalem dwells amid the nations
tmp:2232: or nafshah — the light of the wife's (destined soulmate's) soul, which is the trunk of the tree whose spreading radiance is one's money
tmp:2233: ikkar ha-ilan — the trunk/root of the tree in the wife-money-children allegory, identified with the light of the soulmate's soul from which the money-branches spread
tmp:2234: da'at oto yitbarakh — knowing God Himself ('had I known Him I would be Him'), the cognitive union whereby the intellect, and thus the whole person, is where it thinks
tmp:2235: the essence of being included in the One (nikhlal be-Echad) — merging with God attained through knowing Him, granting eternal life and perfection
tmp:2236: aravah — the willow branch (Hoshana Rabba), resembling lips, symbol of speech without da'at, like one who stammers Torah without understanding (Zohar Kedoshim 85b)
tmp:2237: arvin — 'guarantors' in 'a person's feet are his guarantors' (Sukkah 53a), punned with arvei nachal (brook willows), the feet as channels of water
tmp:2239: 'asa'ah ke-otzar — [Torah as] a treasury made through fear of Heaven ('the fear of the Lord is His treasure,' Isa. 33:6), the storehouse aspect linked to yirah
tmp:2241: the souls of Israel who study and comprehend Torah — likened to the herbs and grasses growing in the garden (Torah), nourished by the spring of Chokhmah
tmp:2242: asavin u-desha'in — the herbs and grasses growing in the garden (Tikkunei Zohar 14), symbol of Israel's souls who study and understand Torah
tmp:2243: 'like ones drunk on wine' (ki-shetuyei yayin) — the intoxicated appearance of the dead of the desert, aspect of ruddy Esav, the master of the kelipah
tmp:2244: studying from a written book — Torah study in the aspect of Asiyah/'na'aseh' (the crown Israel lost), weaker to arouse than hearing from the tzaddik's mouth
tmp:2245: ma'asekha — 'Your works' (Ps. 145:10), expounded as the aspect of Asiyah/action and the body, paired against 'Your pious ones' as the soul
